entrypoints.summary: LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput accepts attacker-controlled archive bytes, enables all formats and filters, opens the bytes from memory, iterates headers, and drains entry content through archive_read_data.

affected_components.role: RAR decompression/filter handling and propagation of the expansion end boundary

code_slices.fixed: expand() returns an archive status and writes the end through an int64_t out-parameter. read_data_compressed and run_filters return on non-OK status, and run_filters rejects tend < 0 before conversion to size_t.
code_slices.surrounding_context: The RAR reader routes compressed data through filter handling and LZSS operations; the public fuzz harness reaches this processing by repeatedly calling archive_read_data.
code_slices.vulnerable: Before the patch, expand() returned an int64 result that callers used as the expansion end; negative results represented errors in the old contract.

negative_controls: Use the fixed commit containing the status/out-parameter change.

observability.positive_marker: Heap-use-after-free READ 4 with archive_read_format_rar_read_data at the top of the recorded crash state.

impact.affected_asset: Memory safety and integrity of the process using libarchive's RAR reader.
impact.attacker_capability: Cause the documented memory-safety read in a process that parses attacker-supplied archive data.
impact.security_effect: Heap-use-after-free read during processing of crafted RAR v4 content.

causal_trace.summary: A crafted RAR archive is supplied as arbitrary in-memory input to the libarchive fuzz harness, which enables the RAR format path and reads archive entry data.

The pre-fix RAR filter path overloaded expand()'s integer result as both a positional end boundary and an error signal; callers could continue updating decompression/filter state without first requiring a successful archive status.
The affected RAR reader path reaches the reported heap-use-after-free read in archive_read_format_rar_read_data while archive_read_data processes the archive content.
The disclosed sanitizer oracle classifies the resulting memory-safety failure as a four-byte heap-use-after-free read.

primary_invariant.statement: A decompression end position may be consumed by filter and LZSS processing only when expansion has returned a successful archive status, and it must be nonnegative before conversion to size_t.
primary_invariant.violated_because: The old expand() interface returned an int64 value used as an end position while also returning negative error values; the patch separates status from the end out-parameter and adds a negative-bound check.

quality.review_notes: The OSV record supplies a concrete sanitizer classification and crash state, and the maintainer patch directly identifies the RAR v4 filter UAF and status/value contract change. The supplied regression RAR artifact is named for this PPMd UAF, but no execution transcript proves a replay result; no precise allocation/free/use ownership sequence or stronger exploitation outcome is claimed.

remediation.invariant_restored: expand() returns ARCHIVE_OK or an archive error independently of a valid end out-parameter; callers stop on non-OK status, and run_filters rejects a negative end before casting it to size_t.
mitigation_classes: separate status return from data boundary
validate signed boundary before size conversion

state_context.attacker_state_setup: A crafted RAR v4 archive supplies compressed/filter data accepted by the in-memory archive reader and drained through archive_read_data.
data_structure_invariants: filters.filterstart may constrain the expansion end.
The end boundary is valid for subsequent use only after successful expansion.
A negative signed end must not be converted to size_t for filter processing.

numeric_domains.attacker_constraints: Malformed RAR filter/decompression state can reach the expansion and filter-processing paths; exact malformed field constraints are not included in the bundle.
numeric_domains.name: expansion end boundary
sentinel_values: negative error result in the pre-fix overloaded return contract

state_context.state_machine: RAR compressed-data processing selects an expansion boundary, expands data, and then updates or runs RAR filters using that boundary.

oracle.expected_negative: A build containing the remediation returns/propagates an archive error or otherwise avoids the documented heap-use-after-free read for the same input.
oracle.expected_positive: An affected build processing the issue-specific crafted RAR input through the fuzz harness produces the documented Heap-use-after-free READ 4 in the recorded archive_read_format_rar_read_data → archive_read_data → libarchive_fuzzer.cc state.
